patterns.note: Generous use of negative space, particularly around headings and main content blocks, creating an airy and premium feel.
Prominent, large serif headings (e.g., 'Hi. We're a strategic design and innovation studio.') contrasted with a clean, legible sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A high-contrast monochrome palette of black text on a white background, allowing the dynamic hero visuals to provide the primary visual interest and subtle color.

The initial hero text 'Hi. We're a strategic design and innovation studio.' remains visible at the top of the viewport for a significant scroll depth, while a dynamic, multi-layered visual element (a collage of app interfaces transitioning into a full-bleed video or WebGL background) scrolls underneath it, creating a parallax-like effect before the text eventually scrolls out of view.
Client names are presented as a continuous, horizontally wrapping list of text links, rather than a grid of logos, emphasizing the breadth of their partnerships.

technique_notes: The hero section features a primary text statement that is initially positioned at the top of the viewport and remains sticky for a substantial scroll duration. Concurrently, a rich visual background, composed of a collage of app screenshots that then transitions into a full-bleed video or WebGL animation, scrolls upwards beneath this text, creating a layered parallax effect. This dynamic background provides visual interest and depth as the user scrolls, eventually revealing the subsequent content sections.
Content sections below the hero appear with a simple scroll-up, maintaining a clean, direct presentation without complex reveal animations.
The site uses a high-contrast typographic hierarchy with large, elegant serif headings for impact and clear sans-serif for readability in body copy.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold serif headings (~3-4x body text) for primary statements, with a clear, readable sans-serif for body and navigation.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout all visible elements, maintaining a crisp, modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with significant vertical spacing between major sections and generous line-heights for body text, contributing to a premium and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site's distinctive design lies in its sophisticated blend of classic, elegant serif typography for primary messaging with a highly dynamic, modern, and almost abstract visual hero. This creates a powerful contrast between timeless authority and cutting-edge innovation, avoiding generic templates by making the hero a truly unique, interactive visual experience rather than a static image or simple video.
